```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import CartesianCategorization, MultiAxisCut

# Jet multiplicity binning: exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets of JetGood
jet_multiplicity = MultiAxisCut(
    variable="nJetGood",
    bins=[
        (4, 4, "4j"),
        (5, 5, "5j"),
        (6, float("inf"), "6j"),
    ]
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets
btag_multiplicity = MultiAxisCut(
    variable="nBJetGood",
    bins=[
        (2, 2, "2b"),
        (3, float("inf"), "3b"),
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = CartesianCategorization(
    axes=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)
```
